For normalized r0=(1/4,1/4,1/2), map Sym3->R3 L->Lr0 has rank3, with 3-dimensional kernel.
Take v=(1,-1,0), v·r0=0; define L(t)=E33+t vv^T PSD for all t>=0.
Show L(t)r0=(0,0,1/2) for all t; all yield exposed g=(1,1,3/2).
At normalized r1=(2/3,0,1/3), g(t)=(1+2t/3,1-2t/3,4/3), so t0 and t1/2 differ exactly.
The original native source and all reviewed sources do not select t, and a classical matched Hamiltonian has identical dynamics.
